subject: Medford Square Zoning and Redevelopment
overview: The City Council referred major zoning updates for Medford Square to the Community Development Board, selected Transom Real Estate as the preferred developer for the Medford Square parking lots, and ordained an ordinance protecting gender-affirming and reproductive healthcare.

items.title: Resolution in Memory of William Shane Horty
items.summary: Approved a resolution in memory of lifelong resident and retired firefighter William Shane Horty.

items.title: Resolution Recognizing Food Allergy Awareness Week
items.summary: Approved a resolution recognizing May 11 to 17, 2025, as Food Allergy Awareness Week in Medford.

items.title: Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes of April 8, 2025, and April 29, 2025.

items.title: Reports of Committees
items.summary: Approved joint reports from committees covering the municipal budget, zoning, the Human Rights Commission, and police body-worn cameras.

items.title: Veterans Department Event Listening Session
items.summary: Referred a resolution to have city councilors attend the Veterans Coffee and Cookies Hour to the Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee.

items.title: Resolution to Invite the Office of Prevention Outreach
items.summary: Referred a resolution inviting staff from the Office of Prevention Outreach to a committee meeting to the Resident Services and Public Engagement Committee.

items.title: Special Permit Amendment for 282 Mystic Avenue
items.summary: Continued the public hearing on Clear Channel's petition to upgrade billboard digital screens to May 27, 2025, because the petitioner was not present.

items.title: Common Victualler License Operating Hours Amendment
items.summary: Approved extending operating hours to 1 a.m. for The Establishment Restaurant with a 30-60-90 day review.

items.title: Human Rights Commission Ordinance Update
items.summary: Approved on first reading an amended ordinance updating the composition, administrative structure, and reporting requirements of the Human Rights Commission.

items.title: Medford Square and West Medford Square District Zoning Amendments
items.summary: Referred draft zoning ordinance updates for the Medford Square and West Medford Square districts to the Community Development Board.

items.title: Medford Square Parking Lot Development Update
items.summary: Received a presentation on the Request for Proposals for the lease and development of Medford Square parking lots, designating Transom Real Estate as the preferred developer to begin negotiations.

items.title: Parking Ordinance Amendment for City Hall Lots
items.summary: Approved on first reading a repeal of municipal employee parking ordinances to allow the Traffic Commission to update and enforce new regulations at City Hall.

items.title: Carr Park Phase II Contingency Funding
items.summary: Approved an appropriation of $65,000 in free cash matched with $65,000 in Community Preservation Act funds for Carr Park construction contingency.

items.title: Pop-up Community Garden Funding
items.summary: Approved an appropriation of $5,500 in Community Preservation Act funds for a temporary community garden adjacent to the Senior Center in Medford Square.

items.title: School Security Upgrades Lease Financing
items.summary: Authorized a five-year lease-purchase financing agreement for camera, access, and security vestibule upgrades across public school buildings.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Heard from residents and councilors regarding recent federal immigration enforcement activities and the municipal response to ICE presence.

items.title: Gender Affirming Care and Reproductive Care Ordinance
items.summary: Took the reproductive and gender-affirming healthcare protection ordinance from the table and ordained it on third reading.
